info.title: Velane Control Plane API
info.description: HTTP API for Velane authentication, tenant administration, workflows, integrations, invocation, observability, and embeds. Unless stated otherwise, authenticated operations accept either a Velane API key (`vl_...`), a session JWT, or the session cookie. The `x-required-scope` extension records the minimum API-key scope or session role.

put.summary: Create or fully replace a KV entry
put.description: Idempotently replaces the entry value and TTL. Omitting `ttl_seconds` (or sending `null`) clears any existing expiry; it does not leave the previous expiry unchanged. The raw request body is capped at `max_value_bytes + 4096` bytes for transport safety, while the authoritative stored-value limit is PostgreSQL's canonical JSONB text size (`octet_length(value::text)`). Either limit can return 413, so an encoding may be rejected even when its canonical JSON value would fit.
